summary: Tested ClutchArena MVP - backend has 16/19 (84%) pytest passing; the 3 failures are test-script mismatches with actual response shapes (NOT real backend bugs). Frontend had a CRITICAL bundling failure (Text.tsx imported './theme' instead of '../theme'); fixed by testing agent, app now loads. Login as player@clutcharena.com succeeds, home shows wallet ₹950 (₹850 baseline + ₹100 mock deposit from test), 4 sub-wallets, quick actions, banners and 5 upcoming tournaments rendered.

minor.issue: Response does not directly contain 'email' at top level (likely nested under 'user'). Test expected flat shape. Verify frontend reads correct path.
Returns {kyc_status, record} instead of {status}. Confirm frontend uses 'kyc_status' key.
Requires 'game' and 'mode' fields (422 when missing). Document in API contract; ensure frontend create-team form sends them.

ui_bugs.issue: Import path was './theme' (resolves to non-existent src/components/theme) - caused Metro bundling to fail entirely. FIXED by testing agent to '../theme'.

issues: Renders cleanly. Email/password inputs missing testID attributes - selectors had to fall back to positional input querying.
Wallet card, 4 sub-wallets, quick actions, 2 banners and tournament list all render correctly on 390x844 viewport.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns: 'textShadow*' deprecated (use 'textShadow'), 'shadow*' deprecated (use 'boxShadow'), props.pointerEvents deprecated. Non-blocking but worth cleaning.
useNativeDriver warning - expected on web preview, safe to ignore.

action_items: Add testID attributes on critical interactive elements: login-email, login-password, login-submit, tab buttons, tournament-card, deposit/withdraw buttons for reliable e2e testing.
Verify documented contracts for /api/auth/me, /api/kyc/status, /api/teams match frontend usage (3 minor key-name mismatches surfaced by tests).
Address React Native style deprecation warnings (textShadow*, shadow*, pointerEvents).
Optional: deeper E2E for tournament registration → wallet debit ordering (bonus→deposit→winning), withdraw KYC gate, admin panel pending lists, and OTP login flow on UI.
critical_code_review_comments: Text.tsx import path was clearly wrong - suggests no smoke build was run before handoff. Consider adding a CI step that runs `expo export -p web` to catch import resolution issues early.
Many screens reference '@/src/components/Text' which depends on the fixed file; ensure other components don't have similar relative-path mistakes.

success_rate.backend: 84% (16/19) - failures are test-assertion mismatches, not real bugs
success_rate.frontend: Loads and renders correctly after fix; login + home verified, deep navigation not fully exercised

seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Backend auto-seeds admin, test player (wallet 500+250+100), 5 tournaments, 2 banners. One mock ₹100 deposit credited during testing (wallet now 600+250+100=950).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend public URL: https://arena-compete-6.preview.emergentagent.com. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_clutcharena.py. The 3 failing tests need updating to match real response keys: auth/me returns wrapped user, kyc/status returns kyc_status key, teams requires game+mode. Frontend lacks testID on most elements - use text-based selectors or ask main agent to add testIDs. Mock OTP code = 123456.
rca_of_issue: CRITICAL frontend blocker: /app/frontend/src/components/Text.tsx had `import { colors } from './theme'` but theme.ts lives at /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (one level up). Metro could not resolve the module and the entire bundle failed (all routes blank). Fix: changed to `from '../theme'`. After Metro cache clear and restart, app boots normally.
